mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may increase susceptibility to infections in patients receiving adalimumab immunosuppression, and thiazide diuretics can potentiate electrolyte abnormalities affecting cardiac stability.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly; ensure adequate potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent; monitor for signs of infection given adalimumab's immunosuppressive effects.
